Key.Original: Manufacturer: Astra-Unceta y Cia SA%1Length: 6.3 inches%1Ammunition: 9x17mm Short%1Rate of Fire: 25 rpm%1Weight: 0.630kg%1Firing Mode(s): Semi-Automatic%1Magazine: 6-round box magazine%1Effective Range: 25 meters%1%1The Astra 300 is a compact Spanish semi-automatic pistol introduced in the early 1920s by Astra-Unceta y Cía as a smaller version of the Astra 400. It operated on a simple blowback system and featured a solid all-steel construction with a streamlined, service-oriented design suited to military and police use. During the Second World War, Germany placed a substantial order for the pistol, and approximately 85,000 were delivered to the Wehrmacht between 1941 and 1944, of which 63,000 were chambered in in 9×17mm Short.
